nodes.label: Server-Side Form Recipient Constant
nodes.rationale: The recipient used to be read from a hidden field in the public form, which let anyone POST their own address and have the site mail it for them. It is now a server-side constant, overridable via TK_FORM_RECIPIENT in wp-config.php.

nodes.label: Elementor CPT Support Registration
nodes.rationale: Only writes the elementor_cpt_support option when it actually needs to change, and only in admin/AJAX/REST contexts where Elementor reads it. It previously ran update_option() on every front-end request.

nodes.label: Buyer Question Running Order
nodes.rationale: Sections run in the order a nervous buyer actually asks: what is this and what does it cost, what happens each day, what is included, what could stop me going, then details. The reserve panel stays pinned alongside the whole way down.

nodes.label: Schema-Generated Page, Not Typed Layout
nodes.rationale: The page is generated entirely from the field schema so a package cannot say 12 days in its title and 14 in its spec block, and adding an eighth package is a data-entry job rather than a page rebuild.

nodes.label: Mobile Menu Focus Trap and Restore
Proportional Depth-of-Field Falloff
nodes.rationale: Blur 0 to 4.5px, opacity 1 to 0.4 and scale 1 to 0.86 all scale continuously with distance from viewport centre rather than toggling. The proportional falloff is what makes it read as depth of field instead of a state change.

nodes.label: Live Reduced-Motion Mode Switch
nodes.rationale: Reduced motion is honoured in both directions mid-session: turning it on stops the drives and shows everything, turning it back off re-arms rather than leaving the gallery stuck at its final state.

nodes.label: Delta-Gated Style Writes
nodes.rationale: Scroll handlers are passive and rAF-throttled, and each card caches its last blur/opacity/scale so a card whose value has not changed is not written to sixty times a second.

nodes.label: One Measurement For Pinned and Swipe Modes
nodes.rationale: Below 900px pinning is off and the track is a native swipe, but 'which card is nearest the middle of the screen' is the same question either way, so one function serves both modes.

nodes.label: Copy Gate
nodes.rationale: Every viewer-facing line is written in docs/design-package.md and ships verbatim; the gate checks nothing drifted on the way to the templates. It scans every PHP file rather than spot-checking because long generation slides toward corporate stock language in the lower sections, not the hero.

nodes.label: Stock Word and AI Tell Blocklist
Placeholders Must Never Reach A Page
nodes.rationale: A site whose central argument is 'check our numbers' cannot print a bracket where a number belongs, so [NUMBER], [ADDRESS], [X] and lorem ipsum are hard failures.

nodes.label: No Em Dashes House Rule
nodes.rationale: Commas and periods instead of em dashes, everywhere, because the em dash is a tell that the sentence wrote itself.

nodes.label: Credentials Section (TAAN, registration)
nodes.rationale: Fraud is the number one objection in this category and both Nepali registers are public, so the site invites verification rather than asking to be believed.

nodes.label: Hero Poster, Video and Founder Portrait Settings
Unset Values Are Omitted, Never Placeholdered
nodes.rationale: A site whose trust argument is 'go check our registration' cannot ship a bracket where a number belongs, so every template omits an empty customizer value rather than printing a placeholder, making a blank field always safe.

nodes.label: Repeater Row Renderer and Admin Assets
One Field Schema, Four Consumers
nodes.rationale: Nothing in the admin UI knows the name of a single field. Adding a field to tk_package_field_schema() makes it appear in the admin, the REST API and the templates at once, with no chance of the four drifting apart.

nodes.label: Open Graph and Twitter Card Tags
Lazy Loading, Dimensions and Async Decoding Filters
tk-* CSS Custom Property Design Tokens
How A Place Is Confirmed Section
Money Objection Before Lineage
nodes.rationale: For an international wire transfer to Nepal, uncertainty about money is a sharper objection than uncertainty about quality (research cites an operator who took over fifteen lakh rupees from seven pilgrims and never ran the trip), so the three steps state exactly when anything is paid, before the lineage section.

nodes.label: Kora Ring Interaction Markup
nodes.rationale: The one interactive moment: the visitor walks the 52km circle by holding, performing the site's premise that you do not climb what is sacred, you walk around it, before being told what it means.

nodes.label: Kora Altitude Marker Data
nodes.rationale: Darchen 4675, Dirapuk 4910, Dolma La 5630, Zutulpuk 4790, Darchen 4675: the real altitudes a pilgrim crosses, so the readout is not decoration.

nodes.label: Merit Figure Gated Payoff
nodes.rationale: Sources disagree on whether a Horse Year kora counts thirteen or twelve times, so until the operator confirms their own tradition's figure the completed state says something true and specific instead of guessing at a religious claim.

nodes.label: Press-Instead-Of-Hold Accessibility Path
nodes.rationale: A hold is a pointer gesture, so the control is a real button: keyboard and assistive-technology users complete the circle with one press for the same payoff, and reduced motion gets the completed state with no interaction at all.

nodes.label: One Image, No Carousel
nodes.rationale: Carousels delay the largest paint, nobody sees slide three, and they signal indecision about which photograph is the good one.

nodes.label: hero_focal Focal Point Field
nodes.rationale: A cover-cropped hero puts the shrine off frame on wide or short screens. Saying 'keep Muktinath in shot' via object-position without re-cropping the file is the difference between a usable photograph and an unusable one.

nodes.label: Permits, Fitness and Packing Section
nodes.rationale: Fitness leads the three lists because pilgrims prepare the spiritual side for months and treat the altitude as an afterthought, which is precisely why it catches people out. Empty blocks are filtered out and the whole section returns early if nothing remains.

nodes.label: PHP Syntax Lint Workflow
nodes.rationale: Pinned to PHP 8.4 to match the production runtime at tripkailash.com, so a syntax error CI misses cannot be a version difference.

nodes.label: Muted Autoplay and Sound Toggle
nodes.rationale: Video must not autoplay with sound, so it ships muted with an explicit unmute toggle; a poster image covers slow connections and files should stay under 50MB.
